title: GachaSwipe
tagline: A waifu summoner powered by the M.I.K.A. Engine.
description:
GachaSwipe Suite is an intelligent character matching system, turning Layla's vast persona database into a highly addictive gacha experience. Summon, evaluate, and capture specialized companion archetypes. It enforces consistent persona adherence while letting you unleash unfiltered chaos.

Features:
- M.I.K.A. Engine companion: a roaming chibi proxy that curates your session with rationed mischief — gifts, dares, unsolicited texts, scene shifts, misquotes, and snide commentary (opt-in, consent-capped)
- Intelligent 'tastes' meter dynamically learns your companion preferences from every swipe
- POV Position Engine: background pose direction with first-person POV photo injection, plus the Position Forge for custom packs
- Heat Ladder: characters self-report their mood (Calm → Feverish) and steer scenes autonomously
- Unlockable 'GachaFans' premium pages with a dedicated Spark Token economy and VIP photo expansions
- Interactive 'Neural Breach' minigame to decrypt paywalled content while images render
- Late Night & Degenerate modes to for unhinged encounters
- Integrated SMS chat simulation with a sleek, morphing glassmorphic terminal HUD
- The 'Theme Forge' for building and customizing infinite character archetypes via AI
- Native character portrait generation and dynamic pose requests integrated directly into the chat
